title: Bias In, Bias Out? Evaluating the Folk Wisdom
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on algorithmic fairness and racial bias.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The study focuses on how algorithmic decision rules trained on data from biased human decision-makers can sometimes reverse the original bias, a phenomenon termed 'bias reversal', primarily in the context of racial discrimination.
